fusions.name: Sudden Lunge
fusions.desc: You spring up to 7 tiles onto one enemy and grab it, dealing 14 water damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach.

fusions.name: Lily-Pad Landing
fusions.desc: You leap and come down palms first, dealing 30 water damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. Every hit is a critical hit and leaves the target [Soaked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Springboard
fusions.desc: You push off the ground with both palms and land up to 6 tiles away. Your movement speed rises 15% for 3 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Coiled to Leap
fusions.desc: Every time you dodge a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 5. When you reach 5 they all spend at once: a blow strikes the nearest enemy within 8 tiles for 34% of your weapon damage per stack (170% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
